items.en: Trump stated his intention to declare the Strait of Hormuz US territory after Iran's defeat.

items.en: Settler attacks are expanding in the West Bank, prompting action from Washington.

items.en: An Israeli strike in southern Lebanon reportedly caused at least six fatalities.

items.en: Houthi attacks on a Yemeni port city reportedly killed one and injured eight civilians.

items.en: Hamas warns against Israeli decisions to change the West Bank's legal and political status.
